observations: Photos 0, 1 and 2: one foot-mounted cycloidal style gear reducer with a cast body, painted bright blue, sitting on a tiled floor in a workshop.
Photos 0 to 2: a large round input flange for a motor on one end, a lifting eye bolt and two breather or plug fittings on top.
Photos 0 and 1: a solid output shaft with a keyway, painted yellow, on the other end; a bearing seal visible around it in photo 0.
Photos 0 to 2: no nameplate, rating plate, ratio or brand is visible on any side shown.
Photos 0 to 2: the paint is fresh and covers most bolt heads, which points to a recent repaint; in photo 2 some flange nuts look bare, which can mean it was reassembled after painting.
Photos 0 to 2: watermark 'IFABROS INDUSTRAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI', a dealer's mark; no motor is attached, no clip of it turning, no receipt shown.

identity.kind: cycloidal gear reducer (speed reducer gearbox), foot mounted, cast body
read_from: photos 0, 1 and 2 shape of the unit: cast cycloidal reducer housing, motor flange, foot mount, keyed output shaft

claims.evidence: Photos 0 to 2 show a foot-mounted gear reducer with an input flange and output shaft.
No rating plate is visible in any photo; size alone does not prove the power rating.
The housing in photos 0 to 2 has the ribbed form of a cast body.
The outside looks fresh in photos 0 to 2, but that is a new coat of paint, which can hide an old unit.
Fresh paint over bolt heads, and some bare nuts in photo 2, suggest a refurbish; nothing proves it was never opened.
No motor attached and no clip of the output shaft turning.
No receipt or warranty document is shown.

risks.risk: Worn or broken internal cycloid disc, pins or bearings; it may grind, leak or seize under load
risks.proof: A clip of the reducer driven by a motor, running quietly, with the output shaft turning and no oil leak
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, a core for rebuild

risks.risk: Power rating and ratio lower than claimed
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the rating plate showing model, ratio and power
risks.if_unproven: priced as the smallest rating in the claimed range with unknown ratio

risks.risk: Old used unit repainted to look new
risks.proof: Photo of the removed oil plug and the oil, and close-ups of the shaft seals
risks.if_unproven: priced as a used refurbished unit

risks.risk: Receipt and warranty do not exist
risks.proof: A photo of the receipt and warranty document

risks.risk: The watermarked photos are a dealer's stock pictures, not the unit on offer
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the reducer with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give
risks.if_unproven: priced only on what the photos show, as used

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate showing model, ratio and power
Clip of the reducer running on a motor with the output shaft turning
Fresh photo of the reducer with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give
Photo of the oil from the drain plug and close-ups of the shaft seals
Photo of the receipt and warranty document
response.reason: Photos 0 to 2 show a cast-body cycloidal gear reducer, so it can be priced by type at its worst case, as a non-working used unit at the lowest claimed rating; the fresh paint and the receipt claim do not raise it.
